name: Moving Target
body:
Your speed helps you dodge incoming threats.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13.

Benefit(s): When you move at least 40 feet in a turn, you gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC and Reflex saves until the beginning of your next turn.

Special: This feat is considered to be Dodge for prerequisite purposes.

A fighter may select this feat as a fighter bonus combat feat.
